sig: [[["A", "Good morning, and welcome to day two of the Asia-Pacific Software Summit."], ["A", "Before we begin, I have a few changes to today's schedule to share."], ["A", "First, the keynote by Dr. Hassan, originally scheduled for nine thirty, will now start at ten, as his flight landed later than expected."], ["A", "To fill the gap, we've moved the sponsor showcase forward, so you can visit the exhibition hall right after this announcement."], ["A", "Second, the workshop on API design has been moved from Room 2 to the Grand Ballroom."], ["A", "We've had far more sign-ups than we planned for, which is great news, but Room 2 only seats fifty."], ["A", "Third, the panel discussion on AI in testing has unfortunately been cancelled."], ["A", "If you registered for it, you're welcome to join any other afternoon session instead."], ["A", "Lunch will be served at twelve thirty on the terrace, as planned."], ["A", "The updated schedule is in the conference app, so please refresh it to see the latest version."], ["A", "Thank you, and enjoy the day."]], {"A": "F-GB"}]
